name: ddos-sentinel-monorepository
description: Intelligent DDoS Sentinel - Full Stack Application

scripts.setup: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:ml
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && echo 'Backend setup complete'
scripts.setup:frontend: cd frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && echo 'Frontend setup complete'
scripts.setup:ml: cd ml-service && python -m venv venv && echo 'ML venv created' || echo 'ML service (manual setup required)'
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend & npm run dev:ml
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
